pilot: LAW ME — Live Production Pilot (First Canonical Ingestion Slice)
fetch_path: Real public JSON APIs fetched over the operator network via the browser (Knesset OData ParliamentInfo; data.gov.il CKAN datastore_search). No auth, no bypass. Mapping/validation/dedup/versioning ran through the real pipeline in the container; results persisted to dev via Supabase MCP.
note_on_scope: Bounded real sample per source (browser-mediated fetch). Full 500-cap run is available via the --live CLI from an unblocked network. All figures below are REAL (live data, real pipeline, real dev DB).
